title: Black Cat & Spica
overview: Spica is trying to learn to become a master sorcerer. She has a long ways to go.

title: Magic of the Zodiac
overview: Claude comes up with a training plan for Spica, but it puts her in a bit of a bind.

title: The Magicians of the Zodiac
overview: Spica makes new friends at Diana Academy. She starts by getting Io Taurus out of a bit of a hole.

title: Castor Gemini's Fate
overview: The class is tasked with collecting mandrakes, when Io and Spica end up in a bit of a bugbear.

title: Spica and Aria
overview: Spica is preparing for her midterm exam. Meanwhile, Claude is looking for a student leader for the coven.

title: Midterms
overview: The students are tasked with raiding a gryphon's nest.

title: Cross Magic
overview: Spica and Hana join forces against the gryphon, but their combined magic might not be enough to pass.

title: Winter Camp Begins!!
overview: Spica and her coven-mates begin training with Claude at the camp.

title: Bond of Flames
overview: The Claude Coven begins Professor Hercules's training, which consists of a duel between covens.

title: The Attack
overview: Spica and the others finish their training, but a mysterious girl detains her.

title: Tarf's Purpose, Chiron's Resolve
overview: The coven attempts to escape from Arc and Rigel, and Chiron comes up with an idea.

title: The Superior Magician
overview: The confrontation with Arc and Rigel continues and concludes.

title: Memories of Arcturus
overview: Claude tells Spica the truth about the day of the attack on Diana and the capital.

title: Maids at the House of Regulus
overview: Thanks to the part-time job Spica landed at the Regulus House, she gets to know Leo better.

title: Astraea's Troubles / Herbarium Book
overview: Astrea asks Claude for help, and Spica practices her new powers.

title: Io Taurus Gets to Work
overview: Io wants to be a helpful member of society, but things don't quite work out. Claude offers her volunteer work.

title: Finals
overview: Finals are here, giving Spica and the other midterm flunkers a chance to redeem themselves.

title: Adventures on a Deserted Island
overview: Claude Coven is on an island to complete their finals. Spica ends up in a bit of a sticky situation.

title: Race for the Ruby
overview: Spica competes with Capella, Leo, and Ewe to retrieve a ruby from a demonic bird's beak.

title: Finding the Diamond
overview: Spica's in the lead for now, but she needs to do more to stay ahead.

title: Spica vs. Aria
overview: Spica and Aria duke it out over the diamond.

title: Aria's Dream
overview: There's a reason Aria is so put off by Spica's scholastic ambitions, and it isn't anything to do with her.
